text:
70세 여성 환자, acute pulmonary edema로 입원. Hyperthyroidism 악화 (thyroid storm) 원인.

BP 160/90 mmHg. HR 130 bpm. RR 28 breaths/min. BT 38.4°C. SpO2 88% on room air.

Severe shortness of breath 호소함.

Propranolol 40 mg PO q6h 투여함.

High-flow nasal cannula 적용함.

Foley 유지함.

의식 상태 drowsy 확인됨.

Endocrinology team notify함 for thyroid storm 관리.
